title.narrative: Peace and Conflict Transformation in Northern Kenya.

description.narrative:
Conflict Sensitivity Approaches (CSA) Pilot project is a distinct part of the wider work of the conflict sensitivity consortium which will be implemented at the country level. This pilot project will focus on how conflict sensitivity is applied during project implementation phase. In implementing the pilot, consortium will not fund new projects but will instead examine projects from current project portfolio of member organizations. The Kenya consortium will apply and implement the pilot in two levels: a)Identifying a project that is on-going but implemented through partner organizations b)Identifying project that a member agency is directly implementing and on-going
CAFOD as a consortium member of the Conflict Sensitivity Consortium will undertake a pilot project through partnership This CS pilot project is not generated or implemented to correct errors in the Integrated Peace and Livelihood project but rather to develop and demonstrate effectiveness of conflict sensitivity or present the added value of conflict sensitivity to the target project.The pilot is expected to provide relevant information of conflict sensitivity and will guide members to develop conclusions that focus on changes that are only linked to conflict sensitivity but not improving programme quality. The pilot will provide the consortium members with advocacy messages that will be used in influencing donors and other stakeholders in adopting CSA practice in their work.
The Key purpose of the pilot is: a)To make sure that our pilots draws out evidence based business cases and lessons learnt to inform conflict sensitive programming across our consortium and beyond
Objective of the pilot: a)To generate evidence based conflict sensitive lessons from various phases of pilot implementation b)To identify key interaction indicators from the project through comparative analysis of conflict and project profile/Intervention analysis c)To identify at what stages of the project that conflict blind decision occurs and how this is checked and adapted d)To devise strategies and options of project re-design and adaptation strategy e)To use the pilot lesson as advocacy messages f)To develop CSA tools/checklist
